study: TH07 retail 1.00b Normal Reimu A, four-head parent vs action-preserving five-pass human SFT
prerequisite: Both original phase-handshake engineering games 2171701 and 2171702 and the preassigned 71281 offline SFT metrics passed. Explicit experiment release before outcomes.
host: Momentum only, two isolated CPU Wine/Xvfb slots, default game speed and the same version/build/display
mask: Four independent full action heads (nine directions, focus, fire, Bomb) sampled from raw logits. The frozen original four-tick pause/consume harness applies the sampled physical keys.
assignment: Use the explicit slots/order in assignment_rows; each seed uses the same physical host, CPU set, build and ordinary original game speed for both policies. Native RNG is independent. First six pairs have three parent-first and three candidate-first.
stopping: Start six pairs. Replace technically invalid entire pairs using at most two reserves total and at most two technical-invalid credits per arm. Then add exactly the listed whole fresh pairs sequentially (up to twelve valid pairs) solely until each arm has >=30000 true accumulated Stage 1 native ticks. If exposure or engineering validity fails, report as unqualified.
endpoints: Ordinary full original no-Continue Game Start until true Game Over or ending; Stage 1 original deaths per 10000 native ticks, average last Stage 1 progress, Stage 2 entry, stocks at entry/terminal, actual Bomb spends and Bomb-positive deaths. Independent RNG makes between-arm comparison descriptive.
promotion: Qualify >=6 valid pairs and >=30000 actual Stage 1 native ticks for each arm. Stage 1 deaths per 10000 native ticks candidate/parent <=0.75, candidate mean Stage 1 ticks >= parent, and actual Bomb uses per completed credit candidate/parent within [0.7,1.4]. If parent never casts the ratio is undefined and gate cannot pass. RR>=1 closes this intervention. Report all arms, technical failures, actual Focus, cast totals and rates, Stage 2 arrivals and resources.
movie: First qualified pair in predeclared roster order. Independent private game RNG.
